# not-enough-asks

No asking-price-index group exists for this catalogue item at all (the card's MVP scope: with
ebay-adapter, ebay-sold, cex-adapter and sold-price-book off, Facebook is the only source, and a
missing row reads as unknown, never a guessed number). `facebook` is still recorded as a queried
source, and the scan is still charged: the lookup ran and returned a real answer, "not enough
asks", which is what docs/scan-mode.md's guardrail charges for.
